args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover notes for Marrow Agrisupply:

• Eastbank door-label mismatch (ticket PD-4821): the receiving-door import labels doors E1/E2, but the store's booking sheet uses 01/02. Sort this before anyone reimports, or we'll get duplicates.
• Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift: the morning receiver's appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and the trailer number went on a sticky note. Hollis was to check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number recorded.
• Feature request FR-882: custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review.

Status note: the first two items come from the 9 Jun thread in #central-team, and I haven't confirmed their current status.
